answer: Each new identity locks a 140-credit vesting bond, usable for no other identity. It releases only as a delta of 7 credits after each verified honest epoch, over 20 epochs; a failed epoch releases nothing. A comet sweep each epoch compares work records, and copied records forfeit the whole remaining bond. The kth fake still locks a full 140, so 1,000 fakes lock 140,000 credits, with no recycling until vesting ends. An honest agent locks 140 once. Renting clean histories fails: each record carries a quartz receipt bound to one key, and a second key presenting it freezes both bonds.
